data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 satisfies the relation-form predicate mechanically but the substance is flawed for conn:1a1676a83b27. It asserts a 'shared mechanism' relation yet labels the same cited artifacts as BOTH sharing a mechanism AND contradicting each other, and frames the shared 'mechanism' as a 'misparse' (an error diagnosis) rather than a genuine mechanism common to the endpoints. A substantive shared-mechanism relation must identify a common process/method the endpoints genuinely employ, not merely that they are all wrong in some vaguely related way. The content thus collapses the required relation into a fault taxonomy while still asserting contradiction among the very items it claims share a mechanism.
